confirmed.claim: Zero authentication enforcement on any API endpoint except login/register.
All WebSocket endpoints accept any origin (CheckOrigin always true), enabling cross-site WebSocket hijacking.

confirmed.claim: Errors from scanProjectByID and LastInsertId silently discarded, potentially returning nil projects or stale data in API responses.
Resource leak in ExplorerUpload: defer file.Close() inside for loop keeps all file handles open until function returns.

dismissed.claim: Path traversal in safeJoin allows reading/writing any file on the system.
dismissed.reason: safeJoin works correctly. On Windows, explorer root is C:\ (entire C: drive is valid space — C:\Windows\win.ini is within bounds). On Unix, '..' in Rel output correctly blocks traversal above home directory. Cross-drive access (D:\) blocked. Verified via Go sandbox.
